## 3. Asset Integrity & Governance Rules

1. **Zero Background Pollution:** All transparent PNGs must be rendered on clean, native surface backgrounds without artificial grey/black wrapper borders.
2. **Intentional Placement Only:** Mascots and dashboards are deployed strategically to illustrate complex platform mechanisms, not as decorative filler on every card.
3. **Responsive Scaling:** All dashboard compositions use responsive `max-w` constraints with subtle Framer Motion parallax depth, maintaining crisp sharpness from 320px mobile to 1920px 4K displays.
